details: I still believe maybe along with the drone camera, there could be an option to place pinpoints, and a go butten that will move the camera along the line of those points for filming, as a content creator being able to have the exact movements for multiple shots is a need. And for avatars this most likely won't be considered but more favorites as someone who collects avatars I'm constantly having to pick and choose which ones I keep or deleted even with vrc+ a way to have extra favorites and even a way to search avatar names from right in your menu, a lot of people would pay for it, to have it in the game. Even if it's an extra add on, maybe some where down the line there's a chance, making vrchat safe accessible and fun while keeping the game away from clients as they wish. Thank you for reading if you've made it this far, I can't speak on behalf of everyone but quite the number of the community this is the only things we ever tried to get, you don't have to agree, but I wished to put it out there <3
title: Camera(filmography) and Avatars(search and save list)
